name: s3d-plugin-roomplanner
description: Room planner for Shap3D.ai: draw a room with doors and windows, furnish it from a catalog (living, bedroom, kitchen, dining, office, bath, storage) with snapping to walls and furniture, turn, measure and list what is in it.

scripts.screenshots: powershell -File ../../scripts/screenshots.ps1 -Shots script -Name roomplanner -Out docs -Query "package=roomplanner&file=/plugins/roomplanner/docs/demo.js&command=roomplanner.open&camera=9.4,-5.2,8.6&target=2.7,2.2,0" && powershell -File ../../scripts/screenshots.ps1 -Shots script -Name roomplanner-maisonette -Out docs -Query "package=roomplanner&file=/plugins/roomplanner/docs/demo-maisonette.js&command=roomplanner.open,roomplanner.level1&camera=10.5,-6.5,10.5&target=3.2,2.3,1.4" && powershell -File ../../scripts/screenshots.ps1 -Shots script -Name roomplanner-house -Out docs -Query "package=roomplanner&file=/plugins/roomplanner/docs/demo-house.js&command=roomplanner.open&camera=13,-7.5,11&target=5.4,2.2,0.6"
scripts.screenshots:sh: bash ../../scripts/screenshots.sh --shots script --name roomplanner --out docs --query "package=roomplanner&file=/plugins/roomplanner/docs/demo.js&command=roomplanner.open&camera=9.4,-5.2,8.6&target=2.7,2.2,0" && bash ../../scripts/screenshots.sh --shots script --name roomplanner-maisonette --out docs --query "package=roomplanner&file=/plugins/roomplanner/docs/demo-maisonette.js&command=roomplanner.open,roomplanner.level1&camera=10.5,-6.5,10.5&target=3.2,2.3,1.4" && bash ../../scripts/screenshots.sh --shots script --name roomplanner-house --out docs --query "package=roomplanner&file=/plugins/roomplanner/docs/demo-house.js&command=roomplanner.open&camera=13,-7.5,11&target=5.4,2.2,0.6"
